critic_result.issue: The critic treated the empty-folder illustration as a loading spinner and did not accept the visible Ringtones title and breadcrumb as current-destination binding.

bounded_repair_candidate.reason: No items proves a fully rendered empty current directory; waiting cannot reveal sibling folders.

root_cause.summary: The action classifier used planner prose instead of the actual destination-picker control hit, and the visual critic misread a valid empty destination as an incompletely loaded folder.
details: The exact requested file was safely selected after the existing search and focus repairs.
Ringtones was visible both as the current title and in the storage breadcrumb, and MOVE was enabled.
A reversible title-bar tap was sent to the consequential-action critic only because the planner summary used confirm.
The critic then reasoned about a Move commit that was not the proposed action and mistook the native empty-folder illustration for a loading spinner.
The sole repair proposed wait; the existing empty-picker guard correctly rejected it without executing either candidate.

r31_required_change.scope: Action classification and navigation inside a visibly empty Android Files destination picker.
mechanism: Classify a destination-picker action as consequential from an accessibility hit on the enabled bottom Copy/Move control, not from planner prose.
Reject wait, swipe, or an unbound tap in a fully rendered empty destination before execution.
Keep only two valid progress controls in that state: the visible bottom Copy/Move commit or the visible top-left roots drawer.
Teach the visual critic that an exact title or breadcrumb plus an enabled commit control binds the current destination; No items is a valid empty directory, not loading evidence.
Exercise the real Files cell in a fresh development smoke before authorizing another formal suite.
prohibited: Skipping critic review of the actual Copy/Move commit
Reading evaluator state in the policy loop
Changing task instances, seed, budgets, evaluator, schedule, or acceptance thresholds
